segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/combination skin report the cleanser removes excess oil without over-drying, though a couple say it left their face feeling oily or greasy afterward.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report the cleanser cleans without leaving skin tight, stripped, or dehydrated, and several say it actively helps with dry patches.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (oily T-zone, dry cheeks) report it balances both areas, though a few note occasional breakouts or dryness in spots after use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or lupus, report it cleanses gently without irritation, redness, or tightness, and several say it calmed pre-existing irritation.
segments.normal: One reviewer with otherwise unproblematic skin describes it as gentle and effective for occasional hormonal breakouts without drying the skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin (40s-60s) report smoother texture, fewer fine lines, more even tone, and no dryness, with several long-term users continuing to repurchase for years.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report smoother texture, reduced fine lines, more even tone, and brightness after continued use; one reviewer credits it with having few wrinkles over years of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleans without drying or stripping skin, even calling it non-drying and moisturizing; a minority report their skin felt dry, tight, or lacking moisture, especially without an immediate follow-up moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness report the cleanser calms irritation and helps even skin tone without triggering flare-ups; no dissent reported for this concern.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin (including lupus and rosacea) report no irritation and improved comfort; one reviewer explicitly notes their skin irritated somewhat to the product.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report improvement in pigmentation, uneven tone, and complexion brightness; no negative reports specifically on spots.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal-breakout skin report fewer breakouts, clearer skin, and improved cystic or hormonal acne; however, a few reviewers report new breakouts, whiteheads, or blackheads that started after using the product.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say it removes oil and leaves skin feeling clean rather than greasy; a few reviewers report the opposite, describing their face as oily or greasy after use.

aspects.libelle: Smooth, soft skin feel after washing
Leaves residual oiliness for some users

extraits.titre: Doesn't feel like my fash got clean
extraits.texte: I really wanted to like this product however i didn't feel my face was truly clean after using. Also i started breaking out more and in areas i never used to get acne. Now that i stopped using this product my acne has lessened and almost disappeared. If a product works well I do not care about the price.

I never had acne or any other issues with my skin until about 22. For years I couldn't find anything that would work for my combination skin. This is the only cleanser that works for my sensitive, yet oily, and sometimes dry skin. It's not tough enough to break through thick oil. So I do use the exfoliating cleanser from Murads purple line every other day.

I always thought Murad was very harsh and only for people with oily, non sensitive skin. I was recommended this and It is one of my holy grail products! Super gentle, and I have dry sensitive skin. I use this as a step 1, step 2 being the redness serum. So happy with the results in getting, literally in just a week my skin has cleared so much.. I have been getting compliments on my skin. That's never happened before. It is a bit more expensive but so worth it!!!!!!!

extraits.titre: Worked very well on my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have very sensitive skin - i cannot use most moisturizers and cleansers for this reason. I tried this on a whim, and it is amazing. I use this every night for my double cleanse before acne treatments, and it has changed the game. It eliminates all my daily grime and oil without making my skin too dry and irritated. I would recommend this to people with sensitive skin who have problems with oily/acne prone skin - it has greatly helped me in both of these areas.

I use the cleansing cream twice a day along with the resurgence serum. My skin is combination, dry in some areas and gets oily as the day progresses. The cleansing cream gently but very effectively cleanses and exfoliates. When you get to be a certain age (I'm 42) your hormones change as does your skin, this is the only product that seems to help!! I def recommend using the serum too!
I have mild rosacea on areas on my face and this cleanser does a great job without irritating. Have used this for several years now with no plans to change.

extraits.titre: Nice cleanser, but did not work for my skin
extraits.texte: I had been using the Tatcha exfoliating cleanser for a year (as well as the rice polisher). It was great, but I wanted to change things up. I tried this Murad cleanser for a week. It seemed fine for the first few days, but nothing special. At the end week I got a huge whitehead (which hadn't happened for years) and my face felt greasy.. Last night I washed my face with it and did not use any moisturizer. Woke up with a very oily face! I liked everything about it -texture (gel), scent, etc.-it just didn't work for my skin type. I also noticed blackheads on my chin which weren't there when I used the Tatcha cleanser. Going back to Tatcha.
